0022600021.text: The Mavericks host the Rockets in their sixth game of the 2026-27 season and Emirates NBA Cup West Group A play, with Dallas at 2-2 (0-1 at home) and on a one-game win streak, sitting 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, and 8th in the West. Houston is 4-0 and on a four-game win streak, leading the Southwest and sitting 2nd in the West. The Mavericks trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 128-110 loss in Houston on October 21, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II, Naji Marshall, Santi Aldama, Sergio de Larrea and Tarik Biberovic, while Houston is without Alperen Sengun, Marcus Smart and Steven Adams.
